images.prompt: Photorealistic extreme close-up of a smartphone held in a hand, displaying the vibrant interface of the new Meta 'Seller' app on a high-resolution screen. Soft studio lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the app's clean blue and white design. The background is a softly blurred modern living space. High depth of field, professional tech product photography, crisp details.
images.altText: Meta Seller app interface open on a smartphone for Facebook Marketplace.
images.caption: Meta's new Seller app provides a dedicated hub for managing Facebook Marketplace transactions.

images.prompt: An abstract 3D data visualization illustrating the explosive growth of Facebook Marketplace. A dynamic upward moving graph composed of glowing blue and purple particles, with floating shopping cart and package icons along the trajectory. The background is a dark blue gradient with subtle grid lines. '1 Billion Users' text glows softly. Futuristic, sleek, professional infographic style.
images.altText: 3D infographic showing social commerce and Facebook Marketplace growth trends.
images.caption: Facebook Marketplace has grown to over 1 billion monthly active users, driving Meta's standalone app strategy.

images.prompt: A modern UI/UX design showcase on a bright white background. Three floating smartphone mockups arranged horizontally displaying different screens of the Meta Seller app. The first shows a product listing interface with AI price suggestions. The second shows a unified inbox with buyer messages. The third displays a sleek analytics dashboard with conversion charts. Clean lines, soft shadows, blue accent colors, minimal flat design.
images.altText: Three user interface screens of the Meta Seller app showing listings, inbox, and analytics.
images.caption: The Seller app features advanced listing tools, a unified inbox, and a comprehensive analytics dashboard.

images.prompt: An isometric digital ecosystem illustration. A large central glowing Facebook hub connects to smaller satellite 3D app icons representing Messenger, Instagram, and WhatsApp, with a new distinguished 'Seller' icon branching out. Luminous data paths and nodes connect them. Dark gradient background, neon blue and white accents, technology network concept, clean vector illustration with volumetric lighting.
images.altText: Isometric diagram illustrating Meta's strategy of launching standalone apps like Seller.
images.caption: Meta's standalone app strategy follows the successful model used for Messenger and Facebook Gaming.
